# dish_middle_metal_bowl — realism QA

Evidence: f3126, f3145, f3158. Fixed calibrated cameras and common instance pose. Mean visible IoU 0.896; worst 0.871; RGB histogram intersection 0.822. Review: `../review/dish_middle_metal_bowl_compare.jpg`.

Grades: silhouette B, proportions A, colour_texture B, articulation B, physics B, collision B, instances B.

- Widened base and straightened upper side profile to match observed bowl.
- Added two calibrated evidence views and fit one common pose.
- Replaced eight broad collision walls with 32-sector profile-following shell.
- Round 2: expanded all evidence crops, added the two previously cropped-out flat rim tabs, rebuilt the piecewise revolved bowl profile and refit common pose, yaw and dimensions.
- Round 2: replaced overly matte metal with polished stainless, narrowed the rim, and added source-visible white-bowl reflection context to review lighting only.
- Round 2: triangulated both tab tips in three views, recovered a 4.83-degree local-axis tilt and 39.53-degree yaw, and serialized the full world-from-asset rotation matrix.
- Added three calibrated evidence views, source-only manual masks, numeric IoU and masked RGB histogram comparisons.
- Added physics mass/density/friction/restitution/COM/fragility metadata with uncertainty and synchronized native rigid bodies.

Remaining:
- Both flat tabs are modeled from the expanded source views. The object is treated as one rigid vessel; underside construction and whether any hidden nesting seam exists are unobserved. Exact room reflections and alloy remain approximate.
- The tilted rest pose is photo-fitted. Static support against adjacent dishes and the mismatched external shelf are not independently validated.
- Product identity and actual weighed mass are unverified; physics parameters are explicitly estimated.
- External scene integration: the separate cabinetry support differs from this photo-fitted base by -19.0 mm. Its assumed shelf elevation needs reconciliation; cookware was not moved off its source fit. See review/support_reconciliation.json.

Mass is an engineering prior, not the real product weight. `physics` includes the shell-area check, density, 40% mass uncertainty, per-body COM and contact coefficients. No deformable item is present in this set.

Per-view bounding dimensions and three projected width samples are measured in source pixels. Rim wall thickness, hidden hinge internals and unreadable markings cannot be resolved to physical accuracy from these images; nominal values are not photo measurements.

Previous notes are archived in `../review/before/dish_middle_metal_bowl/notes.md`; current geometry, poses and physical properties are authoritative in `model.json`. GLB contains visuals; load the JSON joints/collision mapping for simulation.
